business_rules.title: Output packages get PACKAGE (18) control numbers
business_rules.statement: Each refinement output package obtains a ControlNumberType.PACKAGE (18) control number.

business_rules.title: Refinement runs are append-only/immutable
business_rules.statement: A refinement run is immutable once created — outputs and waste are append-only additions, never edits.

business_rules.title: Input bulk package → outputs + parent→child lineage
business_rules.statement: executeRefinement consumes a bulk input package and produces output packages, linking parent→child lineage rows; waste is tracked separately.

business_rules.title: Yield is derived, not stored
business_rules.statement: Yield % = sum(output amounts) / input_amount, computed on read from stored amounts (not persisted).

connectors.name: Seam 1 — Control-Number authority
connectors.trigger: Any context mints a traceable record
connectors.effect: A single immutable control number ({prefix}{YYMMDD}-{genocode}, 18 type codes) is issued and never edited/deleted

connectors.name: Seam 2 — Batch release reconciliation gate
connectors.effect: Batch moves to `hold` AND an incident ticket is auto-created (severity high)
connectors.contract: { controlNumber, chemistry, quantity, lineage, product, status } each {expected,actual} -> {batch, reconciliation:{passed,mismatches}, incident}
